_note: School campus layout - SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the walkable world (PROJECT.md section 7). Minimal placeholder campus: TWO buildings forming an L that opens to the SOUTHEAST: a WEST building (running north-south, doors face east) and a NORTH building (running east-west, doors face south). They are NOT connected (a gap between them). A rectangular grass FIELD sits in the middle; the area INSIDE the L is PAVEMENT; everything OUTSIDE is ASPHALT. A parking lot with cars sits far WEST, behind the west building. There are NO outer perimeter walls - only the two buildings (and roof railings) are solid; everything else is walkable. Each building has an exterior STAIRCASE that takes the player up to a second-floor walkable roof (prototype: second floor = the building's roof with railings; real furnished interiors arrive at Milestone 7). The 2D map (Milestone 9) and classroom doors (Milestone 7) are generated from THIS file. Coordinates: x = east(+)/west(-), z = south(+)/north(-), y = up (north is -z). walls are the solid building blocks (center x,z + size w,d) used for BOTH rendering and collision - keep them axis-aligned. Doors line up with classrooms.json by id and sit on the field-facing wall of each room; axis is the direction the door opening runs along (z = opening runs north-south on an east/west-facing wall, x = opening runs east-west on a north/south-facing wall). cars are decorative parked cars (no collision). boundary and gate are METADATA ONLY (not rendered): the gate returns at Milestone 11 (arrival animation). Real room numbers/names arrive at Milestone 16.
